title: Pin reading lists to Home
body: Open a reading list and choose Pin to Home. Each pinned list gets a card on your Home page that opens at your next unread issue and shows how far through the list you are. Finished lists step aside until new issues are added.

title: Easier selecting
body: Once you've ticked a comic, clicking any other cover selects it too, instead of opening the reader. Hold Shift and click to select every issue in between. Clear your selection to go back to reading.

title: Notifications
body: Parker can now let you know when new issues arrive in volumes you follow, when your Year in Review is ready, and when Parker gets new features. Look for the bell at the top of the page. You can choose what you hear about in Account Settings.

title: Faster timelines
body: Character and team timelines load much faster, especially for big names like Batman and Wolverine.

title: Update notifications
body: Parker now checks for new releases once a day and lets admins know. Turn Check for Updates off under Settings > Server to stop Parker contacting GitHub.

title: Notification settings
body: Turn notifications off for everyone under Settings > Features. Read notifications are deleted after 30 days; change this under Settings > System.

title: Choose which Kavita users to import
body: The Kavita migration now lists every Kavita user, and you pick which ones to bring over with their reading progress.
